name: Ben-Deker
title: Solomon's District Governor of Maakhah
summary: Ben-Deker was one of Solomon’s twelve district governors and was responsible for the region around Maakhah, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.

keyEvents.title: District Governor under Solomon
keyEvents.description: Ben-Deker was in charge of one of the twelve districts that supplied provisions to Solomon’s court.
